decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right green, red, blue. Begin elbow-up left-cup approach with open gripper, slowing rotation as it turns downward.
Finish turning left gripper downward above the left cover; retain elbow-up continuity and inspect alignment before descent.
Descend vertically onto the left cover and close; retention will be checked from its movement in RGB.
Lift left cover while closed, then carry it toward the left green block without changing cup orientation.
Lower retained left cup over green, release at table height, and begin vertical clearance. This is the first cover in left-to-right order.
Left block appears covered. Clear it vertically, then move the left arm above the middle cup for the second cover, remaining on the left side of center.
Descend onto the middle cup with a small alignment correction, close, and pause before testing retention.
Corrected zero-motion rejection: lift middle cup and translate over red, retaining orientation and closed grip.
Place the middle cup over red and release, while beginning an elbow-up approach to the right cup. Green remains covered.
Clear the covered middle red block with the left hand. Align the right hand downward above its cup, keeping the arms separated.
Descend onto the right cup and close without rotating it. Left hand waits clear of the two covered blocks.
Lift right cup and carry it over the blue block for the third covering step. Keep grip closed and cup orientation unchanged.
Lower and release the third cover over blue. Keep the other covers undisturbed; next uncovering target is middle red.
All three cups appear placed. Grasp middle cover to uncover red first; right hand lifts clear, leaving green and blue covered.
Lift the middle cover and carry it forward to uncover red first. Keep green and blue covered and preserve cup orientation.
Replan after continuity guard: smaller forward increments carry the retained middle cup away from red, then begin lowering at the front staging position.
Set the removed red cover down in front, release and lift clear. Next target is the left green cover; blue remains untouched.
Move the empty left hand clear of the staged red cover and above the left green cover. Keep right hand stationary and blue covered.
Red is visibly uncovered, with green and blue still covered. Descend to grasp the left green cover for the second uncovering.
Lift and move the left cover forward to uncover green second. Keep blue covered and hold the cup closed without changing orientation.
Stage and release green's removed cup in front. Prepare a stationary grasp on blue's cover; do not lift it until green is confirmed clear.
Green's cover is staged and red remains exposed. Lift blue's cover last and move it forward; retract the empty left hand vertically.
Stage blue's removed cup in front and release it upright. Begin a gradual elbow-up return of the empty left arm toward its origin.
All colors are now exposed and cups staged. Return the left arm to origin; lift the right hand free of its released cup and begin its elbow-up retreat.
Return right arm toward origin along the same elbow-up branch; settle left at origin. All blocks remain uncovered with cups upright in front.
